title: My Chinese teacher
simplified_paragraphs: 因为工作需要，我必须学习汉语，但是学习了一段时间以后，我觉得汉语越来越难，有点儿无聊，不想学了。上个月，一个新的汉语老师来教我，我发现她的方法很不一样。她会让我听中文歌，看中文电影和新闻，我们也会一起讨论很多关于中国的问题。我现在对汉语又有兴趣了。
traditional_paragraphs: 因為工作需要，我必須學習漢語，但是學習了一段時間以後，我覺得漢語越來越難，有點兒無聊，不想學了。上個月，一個新的漢語老師來教我，我發現她的方法很不一樣。她會讓我聽中文歌，看中文電影和新聞，我們也會一起討論很多關於中國的問題。我現在對漢語又有興趣了。
pinyin_paragraphs: yīn wèi gōng zuò xū yào， wǒ bì xū xué xí Hàn yǔ， dàn shì xué xí le yī duàn shí jiān yǐ hòu， wǒ jué de Hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè nán， yǒu diǎn r wú liáo， bù xiǎng xué le。 shàng gè yuè， yī gè xīn de Hàn yǔ lǎo shī lái jiāo wǒ， wǒ fā xiàn tā de fāng fǎ hěn bù yī yàng。 tā huì ràng wǒ tīng Zhōng wén gē， kàn Zhōng wén diàn yǐng hé xīn wén， wǒ men yě huì yī qǐ tǎo lùn hěn duō guān yú Zhōng guó de wèn tí。 wǒ xiàn zài duì Hàn yǔ yòu yǒu xìng qù le。
english_paragraphs: Because of my work needs, I have to learn Chinese, but after studying for a while, I felt that Chinese was getting more and more difficult, a bit boring, and I didn’t want to learn it anymore. Last month, a new Chinese teacher came to teach me, and I found that her approach was very different. She would let me listen to Chinese songs, watch Chinese movies and news, and we would discuss many issues about China together. I am now interested in Chinese again.
english_full: Because of my work needs, I have to learn Chinese, but after studying for a while, I felt that Chinese was getting more and more difficult, a bit boring, and I didn’t want to learn it anymore. Last month, a new Chinese teacher came to teach me, and I found that her approach was very different. She would let me listen to Chinese songs, watch Chinese movies and news, and we would discuss many issues about China together. I am now interested in Chinese again.
